hypothesis: After an unusually large completed one-hour BTC move, ETH and SOL that have not yet incorporated their own pre-event beta-implied share of that move exhibit positive next-six-hour same-direction after-cost expectancy versus trading every identical BTC impulse without the underreaction condition.
economic_mechanism: BTC is the deepest crypto price-discovery market and often absorbs market-wide information and capital-flow shocks first. When a fixed liquid follower has not yet reflected the response implied by its strictly trailing BTC beta, delayed cross-venue and cross-asset information diffusion may create short-lived continuation as arbitrageurs and allocators rebalance. The underreaction requirement, fixed followers, and no opposite-direction rescue distinguish this from generic momentum, cross-sectional winner selection, breakout, squeeze, funding, and shock-reversal hypotheses.

source.point_in_time_reason: BTC is the predeclared leader and ETH/SOL are both mandatory fixed replication followers. No historical universe ranking, membership backfill, or asset winner selection is permitted.
source.data_availability_verification: The referenced immutable selection dataset already passed chronological, hourly-grid, fixed-instrument and normalized-row hashing checks. Prior strategy outcomes were not used to choose this lead-lag rule; the new runner must verify the exact dataset identity before computing this fingerprint's signals or returns.

primary_rule.return_definition: close[t] / close[t-1] - 1 on aligned completed hourly bars
primary_rule.leader_volatility_estimator: sample standard deviation of BTC completed hourly returns over t-168..t-1; signal-bar return excluded
primary_rule.leader_impulse_definition: abs(BTC return[t]) must be strictly greater than both 1.0% and 2.0 times trailing BTC sigma
primary_rule.follower_beta_definition: through-origin ordinary least-squares slope sum(BTC_return_i * follower_return_i) / sum(BTC_return_i ** 2) over the 168 aligned completed returns t-168..t-1; neither series is centered, intercept is fixed to zero, and signal-bar returns excluded
primary_rule.underreaction_gap_definition: Let s=sign(BTC return[t]). The beta-implied gap is s * (beta * BTC return[t] - follower return[t]).
primary_rule.opposite_move_guard: No trade when s * follower return[t] is below -0.005; v1 never treats a large opposite follower move as underreaction.
primary_rule.direction: LONG follower when the qualifying BTC impulse is positive; SHORT follower when it is negative
primary_rule.decision_timestamp: close of completed aligned signal bar t after both leader and follower bars exist
primary_rule.entry: follower open at aligned bar t+1; no same-bar entry
primary_rule.exit: follower open at aligned bar t+7, after six full one-hour post-entry bars; no stop or target in v1
no_trade_rules: missing, duplicated, off-grid, non-hourly or non-common timestamps
fewer than 168 strictly prior aligned returns
an existing position in the same follower has not exited
primary_rule.future_data_policy: No t+1 or later bar may enter impulse, volatility, beta, gap, direction, eligibility, regime or selection features. Future bars are used only for next-open entry and the frozen exit label.
primary_rule.regime_reporting: BULL when BTC signal-bar close is at or above the simple mean of BTC closes t-167..t; otherwise BEAR. Reporting only; never a selector in v1.

baseline.rule: For each fixed follower, use the identical BTC impulse, direction, aligned next-open entry, six-hour exit, chronology and costs, but omit follower beta, implied-gap and opposite-move conditions.
baseline.purpose: Test whether strictly pre-event beta-defined follower underreaction adds incremental economic value beyond generic continuation after a large BTC move.

nav_debit_timing.entry: one half of fees, spread and slippage
nav_debit_timing.exit: remaining half of fees, spread and slippage plus all funding_carry

costs.component_application: Every component is a non-negative debit allocated to each trade in money terms from its entry notional. Stress multiplies every component proportionally. Funding/carry is a conservative fixed debit for the six-hour hold regardless of direction because timestamp-safe historical funding payments are unavailable.
costs.interpretation: Predeclared conservative research proxies, not observed fills or an execution-quality claim. The four components reconcile exactly to the 20 bps base round trip because timestamp-safe executable quotes, fills and funding payments are unavailable.

portfolio_economics.position_sizing_basis: decision-time marked NAV immediately before the entry timestamp
portfolio_economics.gross_exposure_definition: sum of absolute point-in-time marked position values
portfolio_economics.capacity_policy: NO_TRADE when the full 25% NAV entry would breach either cap; never resize
portfolio_economics.simultaneous_follower_allocation: For one qualifying BTC event, ETH and SOL independently receive 25% of decision-time NAV when both are eligible; unallocated capital remains idle with zero interest.
portfolio_economics.event_overlap_policy: ETH and SOL trades from the same BTC impulse share one event_id. A later BTC event may open only a follower whose prior position has exited; portfolio concurrency and gross-exposure caps always apply.

nav_marking.timestamp_order: process exits, then entries, then produce one reconciled NAV row for the timestamp
nav_marking.fills: entry and exit use the frozen follower open prices; costs are debited at the associated trade and reconciled to NAV
nav_marking.endpoints: initial and final NAV rows are flat, and the final NAV equals initial capital plus summed trade gross PnL less explicit costs

short_collateral.reserved_cash: entry notional is reserved as collateral while the short is open
short_collateral.borrow_interest: none beyond the frozen funding_carry cost component
short_collateral.insolvency_policy: NAV is never floored or replenished; zero NAV is terminal and fails the experiment

chronology.alignment: inner join the three required instruments by exact completed hourly timestamp before any feature or split calculation
chronology.split: 60% train / 20% validation / 20% untouched OOS by aligned raw chronological timestamps

per_follower_primary_required: primary challenger validation max-stress mean net bps >= same-follower baseline validation max-stress mean net bps
pooled_primary_required: validation first-half max-stress mean net bps > -20
validation second-half max-stress mean net bps > -20
validation max-stress mean net bps >= pooled baseline validation max-stress mean net bps
for each validation BULL/BEAR regime with >= 5 trades, max-stress mean net bps > -60
sensitivity_required: 35bps-gap pooled train completed trades >= 16 and validation completed trades >= 6
35bps-gap pooled train and validation max-stress mean net bps > 0
65bps-gap pooled train completed trades >= 16 and validation completed trades >= 6
65bps-gap pooled train and validation max-stress mean net bps > 0
sensitivities cannot replace, tune or rescue a failing 50bps primary rule

falsification.primary_falsification_rule: Reject v1 before untouched OOS if either mandatory follower fails its primary sample/economic gate, the pooled primary gate fails, either non-selectable sensitivity fails, or the underreaction challenger fails to match the corresponding no-underreaction baseline.
falsification.insufficient_data_rule: If the immutable source identity, exact timestamp alignment or minimum raw history fails, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without substituting assets, changing dates or opening OOS.
falsification.mechanism_interpretation: A fail falsifies this exact fixed BTC-to-ETH/SOL six-hour underreaction contract only. It does not prove all cross-asset price discovery instantaneous or absent.

search_breadth.multiple_testing_policy: There is one eligible primary fingerprint in this contract, but it is the second primary strategy family examined on dataset 047c098b... . ETH and SOL are mandatory replication cohorts, not selectable alternatives. The 35bps/65bps gap variants are non-selectable falsifiers and cannot replace or rescue the predeclared 50bps primary. Reused train/validation evidence is exploratory only; promotion requires the separately frozen fresh chronological confirmation below.

sequential_reuse_control.historical_untouched_oos_policy: REMAINS_LOCKED; it cannot substitute for the predeclared genuine-forward confirmation

selection_result_policy.on_data_integrity_fail: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; keep OOS locked and repair only the exact data deficiency without substituting instruments or dates.
selection_result_policy.on_pre_oos_fail: REJECT_CURRENT_FINGERPRINT; persist negative evidence and pivot to a materially distinct hypothesis without tuning v1.
selection_result_policy.on_pre_oos_pass: EXPLORATORY_SCREEN_SURVIVES; register this exact fingerprint as the single deep candidate for predeclared genuine-forward confirmation strictly after 2026-09-19T03:00:00+00:00. Reused historical evidence cannot promote it, and historical untouched OOS remains locked.
